aboutShort.subtitle: About Our Center
aboutShort.title: Habib Rohani Medical Center
aboutShort.description: Habib Rohani Medical Center is a premier healthcare facility committed to delivering exceptional, compassionate patient care. Equipped with advanced medical technologies and led by experienced specialist doctors, we provide comprehensive diagnostic, therapeutic, surgical, and preventive services tailored to community health needs around the clock.

aboutPage.title: Excellence in Healthcare
aboutPage.description_p1: Founded in 2025 under License 101879 and Registration Number 178560, Habib Rohani Medical Center is a premier healthcare institution dedicated to providing comprehensive, high-performance medical services across Kabul. Built on a foundation of clinical excellence, our facility pairs modern diagnostic technology with a compassionate, patient-centered approach to ensure accessible, dignified care for every family.
aboutPage.description_p2: Our center is staffed by highly qualified specialist physicians, experienced clinical personnel, and dedicated support teams working around the clock. We offer an extensive range of outpatient care, emergency response, surgical expertise, and advanced diagnostic testing aimed at restoring health, improving clinical outcomes, and fostering long-term wellness throughout our community.

whyUs.title: Why Choose Us?
whyUs.description_p1: At Habib Rohani Medical Center, we prioritize your health, safety, and physical well-being above all else. Our state-of-the-art diagnostic equipment, advanced laboratory technology, strict hygiene protocols, and evidence-based clinical procedures ensure that every patient receives highly precise, dignified, and reliable medical care within a modern, exceptionally clean, and comforting environment designed for optimal healing.
whyUs.description_p2: We stand out due to our compassionate clinical staff, seasoned multi-specialty surgical experts, 24/7 emergency response units, seamless appointment scheduling, and rapid diagnostic result turnarounds. Choosing us means placing your family's health in trusted, certified hands strictly dedicated to delivering medical excellence, unmatched accuracy, transparent consultations, and uncompromised patient safety around the clock.
